---
title: "Study report scaffold"
---

::: {.callout-note title="AI-assisted"}
AI-assisted revision by Codex (GPT-6).
:::

This Quarto book contains an overview scaffold. It does not yet assemble the
study's analyses or model-run reports.

Generate individual reports with the fit and analysis scripts. Each script copies
a template from `docs/` into the output directory beside the run's artefacts.
The recorded-status classifiers, three-stage selection model and DSP accounting
models have separate templates and output layouts. See the repository's
[modelling workflow](https://github.com/dspopulations/us-birth-certificates/blob/main/docs/modelling-workflow.md).
